findings.summary: In Re: Precious Metals Dealers/SafraBank Securities Litigation (MDL 909, JPML, 1991) -- multi-district litigation against Safra banking entities over precious metals dealings
findings.detail: MDL No. 909, filed October 25, 1991 at the Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation, consolidated litigation titled 'In re Precious Metals Dealers/SafraBank Securities Litigation.' This multi-district litigation targeted Safra banking entities over precious metals dealings and securities. The MDL consolidation indicates multiple plaintiffs across multiple districts sued SafraBank over similar claims. Precious metals dealing was a core business of Safra's banking operations, particularly Republic National Bank which was one of the largest precious metals dealers in the US.
